_source: Pokémon Run & Bun Drive folder: Mechanic Changes.txt (v1.07). Anything not listed uses Gen 8 mechanics.
general: Sleep: a Pokémon that switches in asleep has its sleep counter reset.
Weather from abilities (Drizzle, Drought, Sand Stream, Snow Warning) is permanent.
Electric, Grassy and Psychic Terrain boost matching moves by ×1.5 (Gen 8: ×1.3).
Defog does not remove terrain. Steel Roller still does.
Consumed or removed held items are not restored after battle.
No EVs. Battle style is Set. No bag in trainer battles.
Gym trainers and leaders heal your party before battle.
